interpretation: L1 is near-uninformative on IndEgo: the free truth is 22 advancing / 2 no_relevant_work so the always-advancing baseline is 0.9167 and the model scores 0.7083 with kappa -0.135 -- WORSE than the constant. l2_builder_definition: a task is completed when the worker picks an object from one place, puts it in another place, and does so accurately: right object, right destination, no drop or redo. Judge from the visible start and end state, not from how busy the hands look. (BUILDER's definition, not Awign's.)
label_source: L1 free ground truth derived from the IndEgo VIA keystep annotations (4 annotated clips, ONE human annotator); L2 truth is 4/4 completed (zero variance). IndEgo steps are demo-style assembly and may not transfer to factory work.
notes: the model never caught either true gap slice
the sheets are readable (V01: 240/240 exact) so the L1 failure is a judgment failure, not a reading failure
one labeller; the IndEgo L1 truth is derived from annotations that omit task-list steps (TASK.00b)
protocol: 6 evenly spaced 30 s slices per clip spanning start to end (linspace(0,dur-30,6)); 12-tile 4x3 sheet with CLIP-ABSOLUTE timestamps; frozen slice_l1 prompt; same slices as video via the existing analyze_video path (ffmpeg CRF 28, 480p); then ONE l2_text call per clip over its six slice answers using the builder's working definition
